UHC Gold Standard

Carrier: UnitedHealthcare. Plan type: HMO. Period: 2026-01-01.

27 benefits are placed in CARIN SBC benefit categories. 22 benefits have no code in the SBC benefit category code system and are listed, by identity only, in the bps-unmapped-benefit extension.

Converted from Benefit Plan Standard document UNITEDHEALTHCARE_UHC_GOLD_STANDARD (schema version 1.1.0).
